caption: The drawing depicts five rectangular swatches arranged in a cross-like composition on a plain, off-white background. At the top center, there is a swatch with a brown base, featuring wavy vertical stripes and teal circular patterns with brown outlines. Below that and in the center, a blue swatch displays a floral print with white and red flower motifs and green stems scattered throughout. On the left, a brown swatch contains rows of green-bordered ovals, filled with red and white repetitive motifs. On the right, another brown swatch is filled with small, multicolored floral patterns consisting of red, blue, and white, evenly distributed. At the bottom center, a rectangular swatch features alternating vertical bands: red and white with floral designs, and blue, red, and black plaid or checkered patterns. The name "Albert Levone" is written in small, cursive text in the bottom right quadrant.
title: Printed Cotton
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
